evidence.baseline_predictor_provenance: fresh initialization before antecedent state construction

nonclaims: no second MODFLOW hydraulic state variable
baseline predictor coefficients are not antecedent-origin physical tangents
limitations: H1 establishes insufficiency of H_c alone for the frozen real-SWAP carrier, but does not identify which internal state component is causally sufficient.
H2 is NO_MATCH, not falsified: the frozen endpoint enumeration produced no pair meeting both total-water and M1 criteria, so vertical-distribution causality was not probed.
The H3 state effect is deterministic and above the preregistered threshold but very small relative to the tangent magnitude; window dependence is much larger.
Historical _CM and cm/day suffixes are retained as native carrier labels; geometry-based storage observables are metre-scale and no global unit reconciliation is claimed.
Research antecedent commits prepare SWAP state without publishing the production groundwater interface ledger.
